subsystems.notes: Install/resource loading, PyKotor bridge, MCP resource tooling, and animation slot/supermodel resolution exist; shared GameResourceProvider is missing.
Reader/writer boundary, byte-preserving retarget animation injection, and readback gates exist. Full character/model reconstruction remains high risk and must use MCP/PyKotor/Ghidra ground truth.
Unreal to KOTOR and KOTOR to KOTOR have source sampling/import, mapping, solver, preview, custom output names, readiness UX, and staged export gates. KOTOR to Unreal remains an explicit pending mode.
Import, guide, skeleton, and workflow services exist; native KOTOR DAG preservation and golden export/readback tests remain highest-risk gaps.
Hydration, inspection, save pipeline, reference safety, KMAP-aware UI exist. Needs GameResourceProvider integration, undoable edit commands, and ExportJob migration.

KMAP/KMAX, LYT/VIS/WOK, walkmesh, export manifest and package services exist. Scenario object/cutscene authoring, provider-backed palettes, undo commands, and ExportJob package migration remain incomplete.
Qt entry points and grouped facade exist; main window is large and should keep delegating to controllers. Resource, validation, and outliner UIs should move toward Qt models/proxy models.
Shared ValidationBus and ExportJob exist. Retarget export uses ExportJob; Character, Module, Map, FBX, and Patch Manager exports still need migration.

recommended_next_product_slices.module_editor: provider-backed resource tree plus undoable edit/save/reload loop for one safe GIT object field
recommended_next_product_slices.map_builder: KMAP object placement palette backed by provider-loaded Module Studio template types
recommended_next_product_slices.retarget_workbench: T2402 named retarget quality mode and KOTOR to Unreal contract
